description: Sessions side by side: pace, GAP, HR, power (best 5/20 min if curve stored), EF, decoupling, IF, TSS, % Z4-5, cadence and running dynamics, temperature, dew point. `ids` compares those activities; `similar_to` adds stored sessions like it (same type, duration and pace/GAP within tolerance; optionally same_route, easy_only), newest first with `match`. Pass exactly one of `ids` or `similar_to`, otherwise it returns an error; the similar_to filters combine. For one activity in depth use get_activity. E.g. today vs usual easy runs, progress on a route: {"similar_to":23011268235,"same_route":true}.

duration_pct.description: similar_to: duration within ± this % of it

easy_only.description: similar_to: only sessions under 5 % in Z4-5

from.description: similar_to: earliest date searched (default: 365 days before it)

ids.description: 2-10 activity ids to put side by side

pace_s_per_km.description: similar_to: pace or GAP within ± this many s/km

same_route.description: similar_to: same start, end and distance

similar_to.description: Activity id to find stored sessions like

name: compare_activities
title: Compare activities
